messages:
Leah G: quick catch 1: partner asked for a reseller-style private offer where SI bundles count toward marketplace credits. concern: if we allow that, how do we prevent double-dipping with HW rebates?
Owen M: do not allow double-dipping. propose normalized cap: combined partner incentives <= 30% of TCV and max one incentive instrument per partner type (SI or HW).
Tara V: partners want simple math. suggest we publish a clear example in the FAQ: e.g., $300k commit -> $60k total partner incentives cap (20%) = $45k SI voucher + $15k HW rebate.
Marco S: timeline check: marketplace wants listing artifacts by next Fri. partners need co-sign off 72h before public.
marketplace-bot: New pricing doc uploaded for review: https://redwood.app/docs/pricing/partner-hybrid-2139 :file_folder:
Leah G: legal flag: need clause that partner incentives are recorded off-platform and cannot be applied to reduce committed billing amounts.
Owen M: telemetry: tag partner-sourced leads as "partner_bundle" and emit event voucher_issued. dashboard aggregation needed.
Tara V: I'll draft the FAQ example and partner-facing calculator. Leah, can you loop in finance for revenue recognition notes?
Leah G: looping finance now. Marco will coordinate partner sign-off.
Owen M: also think about market perception: customers may misinterpret voucher as discount. add clear UI microcopy: "Voucher = partner-funded services; does not reduce contract commit."
Leah G: ok. action items: Tara FAQ + calc by Wed; Marco coordinate sign-offs by Thu; marketplace team to get artifacts by Fri.
